proposals.title: Exposure concentration: by_regime + by_signal_type×regime×sector = Choppy regime (96.3%) + UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell (22.22%) (96.3%)

claim.what: Concentration risk: by_regime + by_signal_type×regime×sector = Choppy regime (96.3%) + UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell (22.22%); recommended action: Pause new entries in regime=Choppy AND signal_type=UP_TRI, especially UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank additions, until Bank cell share drops below 0.20 via natural Day-6 exits. Consider a DOWN_TRI or index-short hedge sized to ~10-15% of book to offset the directional-long exposure while Choppy×UP_TRI cohort remains at Candidate tier.
claim.expected_effect: Trader awareness of tail risk: If regime flips from Choppy to Bear or a Bank-sector shock hits (RBI surprise, NPA event, index-heavy Bank drawdown), the 22% Bank cluster plus 94% directional-long book takes a correlated drawdown with no validated cohort edge to justify holding through it — losses compound across the monoculture with no offsetting positions.

evidence: UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell at 12/54 = 22.22%, above the 0.20 hard cell threshold
UP_TRI×Choppy×CapGoods cell at 6/54 = 11.11%, a secondary cluster
UP_TRI signal share 45/54 = 83.3%; combined with BULL_PROXY (6) = 94.4% directional-long — effective monoculture
Both concentrated cells match only Candidate-tier Choppy×UP_TRI cohort (n=339) — unvalidated edge
Extends multi-week warn streak of regime + directional-long monoculture on unvalidated cohort
risks: Recommendation may be over-cautious; concentration may be edge-validated
Trader may already be aware; informational only

proposals.reversibility: Informational warning; no system mutation. Suppresses on next run if concentration drops below threshold.

decision_metadata.llm_rationale: Regime concentration is triggered at 96.3% Choppy (52/54, well above the 0.80 threshold) and the UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell breaches the 0.20 cell threshold at 22.22% (12/54). UP_TRI dominates signal mix at 45/54 = 83.3%, and combined with BULL_PROXY the book is 51/54 = 94.4% directional-long — effectively a monoculture. Both concentrated cells match only the Candidate-tier Choppy×UP_TRI cohort (n=339) — unvalidated edge across all concentration axes.
